cd_help_why_title: Why should you use content disclosure settings?
cd_help_why_body: Turning on content disclosure settings adds a disclosure to your post or below your video description, clearly indicating that the post is commercial in nature. This level of transparency is key to building and maintaining the trust of Binbon users and advertisers.
cd_help_when_title: When should you turn on content disclosure settings?
cd_help_when_body: You should turn on content disclosure settings every time you post content that promotes a brand, product, or service on Binbon. It can take one of two forms: the first is content that promotes your own business; the second, which we call branded content, is content that promotes a third-party brand, or its products or services, in exchange for payment or any other incentive. In both cases, posts without proper disclosure may be restricted or removed.
cd_help_how_body:
When turned on, the content disclosure setting adds a label to your post or below your video description. If the post promotes your own brand, the label will be “Promotional content”, and it will be “Paid partnership” if you're promoting a third party and posting branded content.

Turning on content disclosure settings and labeling your post as “Paid partnership” or “Promotional content” won't affect its distribution. It won't affect how our system recommends content to Binbon users.
cd_help_policy_body: When posting content for a third-party brand (branded content), you must make sure your post meets the branded content policy, including turning on the content disclosure setting. Turning it on tells Binbon users that there's a commercial relationship between you and the brand.

cd_help_ads_body:
To make your video work as an ad with Promote or Spark Ads, you must turn on “Ad authorization”. The video will be reviewed according to Binbon's advertising policies.

You can then set up a Promote video from your own Binbon account or any business account tagged on the post. Your video can also be used in Spark Ads: make sure to link your Binbon account to Binbon Ads Manager, or generate a video code for your post and share it with the Binbon Ads Manager account owner who will run the campaign.

To delete a video code or turn off ad authorization, you must stop all active campaigns or ads associated with this video. If you want to turn off ad authorization while an ad is active, you can submit a report in “Settings and privacy”.

You can extend the authorization period or end it.

anchor_intro_title: Allowing brands to attach an anchor to your video
anchor_how_body:
In your ad settings, turn on both "ad authorization" and "anchor authorization". Make sure "only show in ads" is turned off in your display settings.

If a brand attaches an anchor to your video, you will get a notification from Binbon. The branded content disclosure label "Paid partnership" will also be displayed on your video.

Rewards are calculated on a monthly basis, and you'll get a notification with the payment details at the end of the month. Payment will be credited to your Creator Marketplace Pay account and you can find this under the "Profile" tab in your Creator Marketplace account.

Anchor authorization supports a brand's website, lead generation Instant Form, or app download link. Anchor product links are not supported.
